SmartMeterDataset.title: SmartMeterDataset
SmartMeterDataset.description: Metadata record for a cleaned smart meter CSV dataset archived in Firebase Firestore.

ownerId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the dataset owner.

recordCount.description: Total number of cleaned smart meter readings stored across chunks.

sizeBytes.description: UTF-8 byte size of the archived CSV content.

chunkCount.description: Number of CSV chunk documents stored under the chunks subcollection.

totalEnergyKwh.description: Aggregate kWh across all readings in this archived dataset.

dateRangeStart.description: Earliest UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the dataset.

dateRangeEnd.description: Latest UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the dataset.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the dataset was archived.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the dataset metadata was last updated.

DatasetChunk.title: DatasetChunk
DatasetChunk.description: Immutable UTF-8 CSV chunk belonging to a parent SmartMeterDataset document.

ownerId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the parent dataset owner.

csvContent.description: UTF-8 CSV text slice bounded well below Firestore's 1MB document limit.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the chunk was written.

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Per-user ARIMA default model preferences synced to Firebase Firestore.

ownerId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

defaultHorizon.description: Default forecast horizon in hours (12, 24, or 48).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest preference update.

/datasets/{datasetId}.description: Owner-scoped smart meter dataset metadata documents.

/datasets/{datasetId}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Immutable CSV payload chunks atomically linked to a parent dataset.

/userSettings/{userId}.description: Owner-only ARIMA model preferences keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
